services.name: Charter Boat
services.desc: Plan your day of fun in the sun! 5 Hours About Get ready to have some fun! Come aboard our Beautiful 27 foot Pontoon boat with some friends and family for a charter adventure with Captain Miles. Bring your coolers, snacks, playlists, towels and sunscreen. Explore all there is to see of Ossipee lake and beyond. From the inlets and sandbars to the dam. Want to go tubing? Oh yea it's a blast for all. Or we can find that out of the way cove to just relax. services.name: 11 Person Rental Boat
services.desc: 20' of pontoon fun! This 20' long 8 1/2' wide Sweetwater pontoon boat is powered by a 25hp EFI Yamaha engine. It is rated for up to 11 passengers. The New Hampshire Safe Boaters License is NOT required for the rental of this boat. The boat has a bluetooth compatible stereo and a Bimini top for shade. This is an excellent choice for being able to see the entire lake and back bays without breaking the bank paying for gas. It is very economical. It is also available for the surrounding lakes or longer rental periods, please call for details. Up to 11 People • Rental options from 1-14 days • All Ages Welcome
